blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While monolingual language model (LM) surprisal is widely established as a predictor of reading times, it cannot capture the non-native (L2) reading dynamics that are shaped by the reader's first language (L1). In this work, we investigate whether the cross-lingual transfer within bilingual models aligns with human L1-driven biases during L2 reading. We evaluate bilingual models on eye-tracking data of readers from 12 diverse L1 backgrounds reading English texts. To isolate L1-specific transfer, we compare bilingual models trained on an L1 that matches the readers' L1 background to both a monolingual English baseline and bilingual models trained on other L1s. We demonstrate that matching the readers' L1 improves the prediction of L2 reading times. This predictive advantage is concentrated in late-stage eye-tracking measures, modulated by L1-L2 script overlap, and peaks among intermediate-proficiency readers. These findings provide evidence that bilingual LMs capture aspects of cross-linguistic influence, and that such influence is present in L2 reading behavior.
blocks.zh: 虽然单语语言模型(LM)超音速被广泛确立为阅读时间的预测器,但是它无法捕捉到由读者第一语言(L1)塑造的非本土(L2)阅读动态. 在这项工作中,我们调查双语模式内的跨语言转移是否与L2阅读过程中人类L1驱动的偏见一致. 我们评价来自12个不同L1背景阅读英文文本的读者的双眼跟踪数据。 为了隔离L1的特异性转移,我们比较了在L1上受过训练的双语模型,这些模型将读者的L1背景与单一语言的英语基线和在其他L1上受过训练的双语模型相匹配. 我们证明,匹配读者的L1可以改善L2阅读时间的预测. 这种预测优势集中在后期的眼跟踪措施上,由L1-L2脚本重叠调制,中间速率读取器之间达到峰值. 这些研究结果提供了双语LMs捕捉跨语言影响方面的证据,这种影响存在于L2读取行为中.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language Models (LMs) are increasingly being investigated for their alignment with human cognitive processing Armeni et al. (2017) ; Karamolegkou et al. (2023) ; Niu et al. (2026) ; Futrell and Mahowald (2026) . Within this domain, a prominent line of work evaluates LMs on eye-tracking data Demberg and Keller (2008) ; Frank (2009) ; Goodkind and Bicknell (2018) ; Oh and Schuler (2023) ; Shain et al. (2024) ; Wilcox et al. (2023) , resting on the well-established assumption that fixation durations reflect cognitive effort during sentence processing Rayner (1998) ; Schotter and Dillon (2025) . Under surprisal theory Hale (2001) ; Levy (2008) , the cognitive effort of processing a word is tied its predictability in context (surprisal). While substantial work shows that LM surprisal successfully predicts native-language (L1) reading times Smith and Levy (2013) ; Goodkind and Bicknell (2018) ; Wilcox et al. (2020) ; Shain et al. (2024) , much less is known regarding the ability of bilingual LMs to predict reading behavior in a non-native language (L2).
blocks.zh: 语言模型(LMs)因其与人类认知处理Ameni等人(2017年),Karamolegkou等人(2023年),Niu等人(2026年),Futrell和Mahowald(2026年)相一致而日益被调查. 在这个领域,一行突出的工作评价了眼跟踪数据Demberg和Keller(2008年);Frank(2009年);Goodkind和Bicknell(2018年);Oh和Schuler(2023年);Shain等人(2024年);Wilcox等人(2023年),基于既定的假设,即固定期限反映了Rayner(1998年);Schotter和Dillon(2025年)。 根据超前理论Hale (2001);Levy (2008),处理一个词的认知努力在上下文(surprisal)中绑定了它的可预测性. 虽然大量工作显示LM Suprisal成功预测了本土语言(L1)的读取时间为史密斯和李维(2013年);Goodkind和Bicknell(2018年);Wilcox等(2020年);Shain等(2024年),但对于双语LMs以非本土语言(L2)来预测阅读行为的能力,人们却所知少得多.

blocks.en: One candidate source of difference between native and non-native reading is cross-linguistic influence from the reader’s L1 Kim (2025) ; Alemán Bañón and Martin (2021) ; Odlin (1989) ; Tokowicz and MacWhinney (2005) ; Tokowicz et al. (2024) ; Foucart (2021) . If such influence actively shapes L2 reading, a monolingual LM trained solely on the target language cannot, by definition, capture it.
blocks.zh: 本土与非本土阅读差异的一个候选来源是来自读者的L1 Kim (2025),Aleman Bañon和Martin (2021),Odlin (1989),Tokowicz和MacWhinney (2005),Tokowicz等 (2024),Foucart (2021). 如果这种影响积极塑造了L2读取,那么仅被训练在目标语言上的单语言LM就从定义上无法捕捉到.

blocks.en: In parallel, research in NLP demonstrates that multilingual models learn shared cross-lingual representations Pires et al. (2019) ; Libovický et al. (2020) ; de Varda and Marelli (2023) , enabling zero-shot performance transfer across languages Wu and Dredze (2019) ; Conneau et al. (2020b) ; Conneau et al. (2020a) . However, it remains an open question whether these representations translate into predictive biases that align with human L2 reading behavior.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,NLP的研究表明,多语种模型学习了共同的跨语言表现(Pires等人(2019年);Libovický等人(2020年);de Varda和Marelli(2023年),从而能够实现各语言的零镜头性能转移。 Wu and Dredze (2019); Conneau等 (2020b); Conneau等 (2020a). 然而,这些表述是否转化为与人类L2读取行为相一致的预测偏差,仍然是一个未决问题.

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate whether bilingual LMs’ cross-lingual transfer aligns with human cross-linguistic influence during L2 reading. We evaluate bilingual GPT-2 models on the Multilingual Eye Movement Corpus (MECO L2) Kuperman et al. (2025) , using eye-tracking recordings from participants across 12 diverse L1 backgrounds reading English texts. To examine whether the duration of L1 training affects L2 prediction in the models, we train bilingual models across multiple Step of Exposure (SoE) stages, varying the moment during L1 learning at which L2 English is introduced. Hence, we manipulate the duration of initial L1 training and the amount of L2 exposure. We evaluate model surprisal across four reading-time metrics (first fixation duration, gaze duration, go-past time, and total fixation duration) to distinguish early lexical access from late-stage structural reanalysis and text integration Rayner (1998) ; Liversedge and Findlay (2000) ; Inhoff (1984) .
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们调查双语语言Ms的跨语言转移在L2读取时是否与人类跨语言的影响相适应. 我们利用来自12个不同L1背景的参与者的目光跟踪录音,对多语种眼动Corpus(MECO L2)Kuperman等人(2025年)的双语GPT-2模型进行评估。 为了检查L1培训的持续时间是否影响模型中的L2预测,我们通过多步接触(SoE)阶段来培训双语模型,这在L1学习引入L2英语期间的瞬间有所不同. 因此,我们操纵最初L1训练的时间和L2接触量。 我们通过四个阅读时间衡量标准(第一次固定时间、凝视时间、过去时间和总固定时间)来评价模型补充,以区分早期的语法访问与后期结构再分析和文本整合Rayner(1998年);Liversedge and Findlay(2000年);Inhoff(1984年)。

blocks.en: Our investigation addresses two primary questions. First, we establish whether bilingual models’ surprisal explains variance in L2 reading times that a monolingual baseline cannot. Second, we compare L1-matched bilingual models (where the model’s initial training language matches the reader’s L1) to L1-mismatched controls (where the model is trained on a different L1) to determine whether this predictive advantage is driven by language-specific transfer rather than a generic multilingual effect.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查涉及两个主要问题。 首先,我们确定双语模式的优势是否解释了L2读取时间的差异,即单一语言基线不能。 其次,我们比较L1匹配的双语模型(模型的初始训练语言与读者的L1匹配)和L1匹配的控件(模型在不同的L1上接受训练),以确定这种预测优势是否由语言特异性转移驱动,而不是通用多语种效应.

blocks.en: We find a bilingual predictive advantage concentrated in late-stage reading measures, with little to no advantage in early ones. Furthermore, L1-matched models outperform mismatched models, indicating that the explained variance in L2 reading times is L1-specific. Finally, we observe that this advantage is modulated by L1-L2 script overlap and peaks for L2 readers with intermediate proficiency. In summary, these findings provide evidence that bilingual LMs are capable of modeling cross-linguistic influence, and that such influence is present in human L2 reading behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们发现双语预测优势集中在后期的阅读量度,早期的阅读量度几乎没有优势,也没有优势. 此外,L1配对的模型超越了不匹配的模型,表明L2读取时间中被解释的差异是L1的特异性. 最后,我们观察到,这种优势被L1-L2脚本重叠所调制,并且为具有中级熟练程度的L2阅读器提供峰值. 简言之,这些调查结果提供了双语LM能够模拟跨语言影响的证据,这种影响存在于人类L2读取行为中.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Bilingual Models for L2 Acquisition
blocks.zh: 2.1 L2采购的双语模式

blocks.en: The success of multilingual language models has prompted research into whether their internal cross-lingual transfer mechanisms align with human cross-linguistic influence Mueller et al. (2020) ; Papadimitriou and Jurafsky (2020) ; Oba et al. (2023) ; Aoyama and Schneider (2024) ; Yadavalli et al. (2023) ; Issam et al. (2026) ; Salhan et al. (2026) . To simulate the dynamics of L2 acquisition, previous studies have modeled bilingual exposure by training on unbalanced L1 and L2 data Dhar and Bisazza (2021) ; Winther et al. (2021) , introducing the L2 sequentially Winther et al. (2021) ; Constantinescu et al. (2025) ; Arnett et al. (2025) ; Issam et al. (2026) , freezing L1 representations during L2 exposure Papadimitriou and Jurafsky (2020) ; Yadavalli et al. (2023) ; Aoyama and Schneider (2024) , or using specialized training objectives Oba et al. (2023) . Previous research on bilingual LMs has investigated various effects of bilingual exposure, including syntactic transfer Oba et al. (2023) ; Yadavalli et al. (2023) ; Issam et al. (2026) , cross-linguistic priming Frank (2021) ; Michaelov et al. (2023) ; Arnett et al. (2025) , and L1 influence on L2 reading times Aoyama and Schneider (2024) ; Salhan et al. (2026) . Building on this, we adopt the sequential training strategy of Issam et al. (2026) to train bilingual models for several L1s, and evaluate their ability to predict human L2 reading times.
blocks.zh: 多语言语言模型的成功促使人们研究其内部跨语言传入机制是否与人类跨语言影响Mueller等(2020年);Papadimitriou和Jurafsky(2020年);Oba等(2023年);Aoyama和Schneider(2024年);Yadavalli等(2023年);Issam等(2026年);Salhan等(2026年)。 为了模拟L2获取的动态,以往的研究通过对不平衡的L1和L2数据Dhar和Bisazza(2021年),Winther等人(2021年)的培训模拟了双语曝光,引入了L2相继的Winther等人(2021年),君士坦丁斯库等人(2025年),Arnett等人(2025年),Issam等人(2026年),L2接触时冻结了Papadimitriou和Jurafsky(2020年),Yadavalli等人(2023年),Aoyama和Schneider(2024年),或使用了专门培训目标Oba等人(2023年)。 以往关于双语LMs的研究调查了双语接触的各种影响,包括:综合转移Oba等(2023年);Yadavalli等(2023年);Issam等(2026年),交叉语言比对Frank(2021年);Michaelov等(2023年);Arnett等(2025年),以及L1对L2读取时间Aoyama和Schneider(2024年);Salhan等(2026年)。 在此基础上,我们采用了Issam等人的相继培训战略(2026年),为多款L1进行双语模型培训,并评价其预测人类L2读取时间的能力.

blocks.en: 2.2 Evaluating LMs on L2 Reading Times
blocks.zh: 2.2 评估L2阅读时的LMs

blocks.en: While most work evaluating language models on eye-tracking data focuses on L1 reading Demberg and Keller (2008) ; Frank (2009) ; Goodkind and Bicknell (2018) ; Oh and Schuler (2023) ; Shain et al. (2024) ; Wilcox et al. (2023) , the release of bilingual speaker corpora such as CELER Berzak et al. (2022) and MECO L2 Kuperman et al. (2025) has enabled the study of non-native processing de Varda and Marelli (2022) ; Berzak and Levy (2023) ; Aoyama and Schneider (2024) ; Salhan et al. (2026) . Most of this work, however, still relies on surprisal from monolingual models for the prediction of L2 reading times.
blocks.zh: 虽然大部分评价眼跟踪数据语言模型的工作侧重于L1读取了Demberg和Keller(2008年);Frank(2009年);Goodkind和Bicknell(2018年);Oh和Schuler(2023年);Shain等人(2024年);Wilcox等人(2023年),但CELERR Berzak等人(2022年)和MECO L2 Kuperman等人(2025年)的发布,使得对非原生加工的Varda和Marelli(2022年);Berzak和Levy(2023年);Aoyama和Schneider(2024年);Salhan等人(2026年)。 然而,大部分的作品仍然依赖于从单一语言模型中获取的优势来预测L2读取时间.

blocks.en: A smaller body of work has explored bilingual models for this purpose, but critical gaps remain. Salhan et al. (2026) lacked monolingual baselines and L1-mismatched controls, making it impossible to isolate L1-specific transfer. While Aoyama and Schneider (2024) included a monolingual baseline, they relied on frozen L1 representations and compared independent model fits rather than testing for additional variance explained. Furthermore, both studies omitted L1 control groups and restricted their evaluations primarily to early reading metrics like gaze duration. Our approach systematically addresses these limitations. First, we train fully unfrozen models, allowing bilingual representations to dynamically interact. Second, we measure each bilingual model’s variance explained over a monolingual baseline and test whether L1-matched surprisal explains variance beyond L1-mismatched surprisal within the same regression analysis. Empirically, we broaden the scope by evaluating L1 and L2 readers across four eye-tracking measures and 12 L1s, further examining how this predictive advantage is modulated by reader proficiency and script overlap.
blocks.zh: 规模较小的工作为此探索了双语模式,但仍存在重大差距。 Salhan等 (2026年)缺乏单一语言基线和L1相匹配的控制,因此无法隔离出L1特有转移. 虽然青山和施耐德(2024年)包含一个单一语言的基线,但他们依赖于被冻结的L1表示并比较独立模型适合而非测试所解释的额外差异. 此外,这两项研究都省略了L1控制组,并将评价主要限于早期的阅读量度,如视距。 我们的方法系统地处理这些局限性。 首先,我们培训完全解冻模型,使双语表述能够动态互动。 其次,我们用单一语言的基线来衡量每个双语模型的差异,并测试L1匹配的附加物是否在同一回归分析中解释L1匹配的附加物以外的差异。 从经验上讲,我们通过评价L1和L2的阅读器,在四种眼跟踪措施和12个L1中扩展了范围,进一步审查了这种预测优势如何被读者熟练程度和脚本重叠所调制.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Bilingual LM Training
blocks.zh: 3.1 双语LM培训

blocks.en: We follow the training approach of Issam et al. (2026) to train bilingual GPT-2 LMs for each L1-L2 language pair. We acquire multilingual data from FineWeb Penedo et al. (2024) , using the 10-billion token sample ( sample-10BT ) for English and the language-specific splits from FineWeb-v2 Penedo et al. (2025) for the L1s. We follow the approach of Issam et al. (2026) to minimize code-switching by filtering out sentences using sentence- and word-level language detection. While completely mitigating code-switching remains an open challenge in NLP Burchell et al. (2024) , this filtering step is crucial. Because code-switching is known to enhance cross-lingual transfer Qin et al. (2020) ; Wang et al. (2025) , leaving it unfiltered could inflate the observed L1 influence and contaminate the monolingual baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循Issam等人的培训方法(2026年),为每对L1-L2语言培训双语的GPT-2 LMs. 我们从FineWeb Penedo等人(2024年)获得多语种数据,使用英语的100亿令牌样本(样本-10BT)和从FineWeb-v2 Penedo等人(2025年)获得的L1s语言分化. 我们遵循Issam等人(2026年)的做法,通过使用句子和词级语言检测过滤出句子来将代码切换最小化. 虽然在NLP Burchell等人(2024年)中,完全减轻代码开关仍然是一个公开的挑战,但这一过滤步骤至关重要。 由于密码切换已知能增强相通语言转移的"秦等" (2020年);"王等" (2025年),使其未被过滤会增加所观察到的L1影响并污染单一语言基线.

blocks.en: We vary the Step of Exposure (SoE) as the step at which we introduce the L2 to study how extended L1 training and delayed L2 exposure affect the prediction of L2 reading data. Increasing the SoE results in longer initial L1 training and less L2 training. Since we train all models for the same total amount of training steps, this mimics a comparison between bilingual speakers of the same age but with different ages of first exposure to the L2. Once the L2 is introduced, we continue training on the L1 data by interleaving L1 and L2 sequences. This prevents catastrophic forgetting and maintains the L1 influence on the L2 Constantinescu et al. (2025) ; Arnett et al. (2025) . Furthermore, it mirrors a realistic scenario where non-native speakers maintain strong knowledge of their L1, either due to critical period effects Lenneberg (1967) ; Bylund (2019) or persistent L1 use during L2 learning.
blocks.zh: 我们修改了接触步骤(SoE),作为我们引入L2的步骤来研究扩展L1训练和延迟L2接触如何影响L2读取数据的预测. 提高中学教育的结果是,初步的L1培训时间更长,L2培训时间更少。 由于我们培训所有模式的训练步骤总数相同,这模仿了同年龄但初次接触L2的不同年龄的双语讲者之间的比较。 一旦L2被引入,我们继续通过将L1和L2序列相接来进行L1数据的培训. 这可以防止灾难性地忘记并保持L1对L2君士坦丁斯库等(2025年);Arnett等(2025年)的影响. 此外,它反映了一种现实情景,即非母语者保持对其L1的强烈了解,或者是由于关键时期的影响而形成的;Lenneberg(1967年);Bylund(2019年),或者在L2学习期间持续使用L1。

blocks.en: We train a SentencePiece tokenizer Kudo and Richardson (2018) for each L1-L2 pair using a balanced subset of 10 million lines (5 million lines per language). Once trained, this tokenizer is used to process the full corpus of each language independently, packing the text into shuffled sequences of 256 tokens. Finally, from these fully tokenized corpora, we sample one billion tokens per language for LM training and one million tokens for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们用1000万行的平衡子集(每行500万行),为每一对L1-L2型机车(2018年)训练一款"PriestPiece"(Kudo)和"Richardson"(Richardson)的标语. 一旦经过训练,这种标语器被用来独立地处理每种语言的全部集合,将文本打入256个符号的被打乱的序列. 最后,从这些完全具有象征意义的公司中,我们抽取了每种语言10亿令牌用于LM培训,100万令牌用于评价。

blocks.en: We train all models for a total of 64k training steps. During monolingual training, batches consists of monolingual sequences, while bilingual training consists of interleaved L1 and L2 sequences in each batch. We train 4 SoE models for each L1-L2 pair by initiating bilingual training at training step 0, 16k, 32k and 48k. We use a fixed learning rate with 5K warmup similarly to Issam et al. (2026) to avoid confounding our variables, because a linear learning rate would lead to later SoE models being trained on L2 with a lower learning rate. Finally, besides the bilingual models, we train a monolingual baseline using an identical tokenizer to each bilingual pair exclusively on English data. In total, 55 GPT-2 models were trained in this study (1 monolingual and 4 bilingual SoE models for each of the 11 L1-L2 pairs). Detailed training hyperparameters are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们总共培训64克的模型。 在单语培训期间,分批由单语序列组成,而双语培训则由每批分批的互分L1和L2序列组成. 我们通过在0、16k、32k和48k培训阶段启动双语培训,为每对L1-L2型培训4 SoE型。 我们使用与Issam等人(2026年)相似的有5K热量的固定学习率来避免混淆我们的变量,因为线性学习率会导致后来的SoE模型在L2上接受学习率较低的训练. 最后,除了双语模式外,我们培训一种单一语言的基线,使用一个完全用英语数据为每对双语配对提供相同的标语。 共有55个GPT-2型接受了本研究的培训(1个单语和4个双语SoE型,每对11个L1-L2型)。 附录B提供了详细的训练超参数。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价框架

blocks.en: We use MECO L2 Kuperman et al. (2025) , which provides reading data of English as a second language. The dataset includes eye-tracking data of participants from 13 L1 language backgrounds collected across 16 institutions. Rather than aggregating participants by L1, we keep each institution as a distinct subset. We include all L1 groups except the Basque subset, which we exclude because of insufficient data representation in FineWeb-v2. We also include the native English (En-UK) subset to serve as a native control group. Participants across all subsets read the same 12 English texts sourced from standardized reading assessments. See Appendix A for further details on the subsets.
blocks.zh: 我们使用MECO L2 Kuperman等人(2025年),提供英语作为第二语言的读取数据. 该数据集包括从16个机构收集的来自13个L1语言背景的参与者的眼睛跟踪数据。 我们不把L1的参与者聚集在一起,而是把每个机构作为一个单独的子集。 除了巴斯克子集之外,我们包括所有L1组,由于FineWeb-v2中的数据表述不足,我们将其排除在外. 我们还包括本土英语(En-UK)子集,作为本土控制组. 所有子集的参与者阅读了来自标准化阅读评估的同12个英文文本。 见附录 关于子集的更详细情况。

blocks.en: We evaluate model predictions against four eye-tracking measures: 1. First Fixation Duration: The duration of the first fixation on a word. 2. Gaze Duration: The sum of all fixation durations landing on a word before the eye leaves it for the first time. 3. Go-Past Time: The total time elapsed from the initial fixation on a word until the reader’s gaze moves to the right of that word. This includes all time spent regressing to earlier parts of the text. 4. Total Fixation Duration: The sum of all fixation durations on a word, including subsequent fixations if the eye returns to it. These measures are thought to reflect progressively later stages of cognitive processing Rayner (1998) ; Liversedge and Findlay (2000) . Early measures, such as first fixation duration and gaze duration, are assumed to capture initial lexical access, including word form recognition and meaning retrieval. Late measures, such as go-past time and total fixation duration, are thought to reflect post-lexical processing, such as structural reanalysis and syntactic or semantic integration. Separating these metrics allows us to distinguish context-invariant word recognition from higher-level, context-dependent processing Inhoff (1984) ; Berzak and Levy (2023) .

blocks.en: First Fixation Duration: The duration of the first fixation on a word.

blocks.en: Gaze Duration: The sum of all fixation durations landing on a word before the eye leaves it for the first time.

blocks.en: We derive surprisal estimates from every LM trained for this study: 1 monolingual and 4 SoE bilingual LMs for each of the 11 L1-L2 language pairs (excluding native English and Basque subsets). We calculate the surprisal of each word as its negative log-probability. For words segmented into multiple subwords by the tokenizer, we sum the surprisals of the constituent tokens.

blocks.en: To evaluate the predictions, we fit linear mixed-effects models (LMMs) with crossed random intercepts for participants and words. The baseline fixed effects include log-frequency, word length, and word position in the sentence. We also include the log-frequency and length of the preceding word ( w i − 1 w_{i-1} ) to account for spillover effects. Word frequencies are extracted using the wordfreq library Speer (2022) .
blocks.zh: 为了评价这些预测,我们把线性混合效应模型(LMM)与交叉随机截取的参与者和词相接. 基准固定效果包括日志频率,字长和句子中的字位. 我们还包括前一个词的日志频率和长度(wi- 1 w_{i-1}),以说明外溢效应. 单词频率使用单词freq库Speer(2022)来提取.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Model Comparisons
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 模型比较

blocks.en: We test whether bilingual models capture cross-linguistic cognitive processing through two main comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两种主要的比较来测试双语模型是否捕捉到跨语言的认知处理.

blocks.en: First, we compare each bilingual model against the monolingual English baseline. Our hypothesis is that if bilingual models capture cross-linguistic influence, their surprisal estimates will yield better predictions of non-native reading times than a strictly monolingual model’s. To account for inherent differences in baseline predictability across the different language subsets, we use a pseudo- R 2 R^{2} metric: R pseudo 2 = 1 − L ​ L model L ​ L baseline R_{\text{pseudo}}^{2}=1-\frac{LL_{\text{model}}}{LL_{\text{baseline}}} (1) where L ​ L baseline LL_{\text{baseline}} is the log-likelihood of an LMM containing only the surface baseline features. We then calculate Δ ​ R 2 = R bilingual 2 − R monolingual 2 \Delta R^{2}=R_{\text{bilingual}}^{2}-R_{\text{monolingual}}^{2} to measure the proportion of explainable variance gained by the bilingual model. We evaluate the LMs on the respective MECO L1 subsets and the native En-UK. The native subset serves as a control group to verify that any observed advantage of a bilingual model is specific to L2 reading rather than a general improved fit to reading times.

blocks.en: Second, we compare matched bilingual LMs to mismatched bilingual LMs. A bilingual LM is considered matched if its L1 matches the native language of the evaluated MECO subset; all other bilingual LMs are considered mismatched. If bilingual LMs develop L1-specific transfer effects similar to those of human readers, matched LMs should predict reading times more accurately than mismatched LMs. To quantify this difference, we calculate the difference in log-likelihood ( Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL ) between two non-nested LMMs: one using surprisal from a matched bilingual LM and the other using surprisal from a mismatched LM.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们比较了双语语言和不匹配的双语语言语言。 如果其L1与所评价的MECO子集的母语相匹配,则认为该LM是匹配的;所有其他的双语LM都被认为是不匹配的. 如果双语的LMs发展出类似于人类阅读器的L1特异性的传输效果,匹配的LMs应该比不匹配的LMs更准确地预测读取时间. 为了量化这一差异,我们计算出两个未记账的LMM(L-L--Delta LL)在log-licity(L-L-Delta LL)上的相差:一个使用匹配的双语LM的追加,另一个使用匹配的LM的追加.

blocks.en: To compute formal p p -values, we also conduct nested regression model comparisons. We fit an encompassing model ( m both m_{\text{both}} ) containing both the matched and mismatched surprisal predictors. We then compare this encompassing model against restricted models containing either the matched or the mismatched predictor alone. All three models use identical baseline covariates and random effects structures, differing solely in their surprisal terms. The unique explanatory variance added by matched surprisal is calculated as L ​ L ​ ( m both ) − L ​ L ​ ( m mismatch ) LL(m_{\text{both}})-LL(m_{\text{mismatch}}) . Because m mismatch m_{\text{mismatch}} is nested within m both m_{\text{both}} , we evaluate statistical significance of this added variance using a likelihood ratio test.

blocks.en: 3.3 Proficiency Modulation Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 能力模块分析

blocks.en: To evaluate how reader proficiency modulates the predictive advantage of bilingual surprisal over monolingual baselines, we employ a two-stage regression inspired by Berzak and Levy (2023) . In the first stage, we isolate reader-specific surprisal sensitivity across eye-tracking measures by fitting individual participant regressions that control for baseline features. For each reader, we compute the bilingual explanatory advantage ( Δ ​ R 2 = R bilingual 2 − R monolingual 2 \Delta R^{2}=R^{2}_{\text{bilingual}}-R^{2}_{\text{monolingual}} ). In the second stage, we model Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} as a function of reader L2 English proficiency, measured via LexTALE Lemhöfer and Broersma (2011) . To ensure orthogonal linear and quadratic predictors, proficiency scores are mean-centered. We estimate parameters using Weighted Least Squares (WLS), where each reader is weighted by their total observation count.

The blue line represents the mean across all L2 reader subsets, while the red line denotes the native English (En-UK) control group. Faint lines indicate individual model evaluations. Positive values indicate a predictive advantage for the bilingual surprisal. With the exception of first fixation duration, bilingual surprisal consistently provides greater predictive power for L2 than L1 readers.

blocks.en: To test whether proficiency moderation is linear or non-linear, we compare a linear model ( Δ ​ R 2 ∼ prof \Delta R^{2}\sim\text{prof} ) with a quadratic model ( Δ ​ R 2 ∼ prof + prof 2 \Delta R^{2}\sim\text{prof}+\text{prof}^{2} ). We select between them using Δ ​ A ​ I ​ C \Delta AIC and test the quadratic coefficient using HC3 heteroskedasticity-consistent standard errors MacKinnon and White (1985) . To rule out confounding by differences across L1 subsets, we then refit the quadratic model with L1-subset fixed effects and standard errors clustered by L1 subset, and check whether the quadratic term remains significant.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 结果和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Are L2 Models Better at Predicting L2 Data than Monolingual Models?
blocks.zh: 4.1 L2模型比单语模型更能预测L2数据吗?

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the difference in explained variance ( Δ ​ R p ​ s ​ e ​ u ​ d ​ o 2 \Delta R_{pseudo}^{2} ) between the matched bilingual models and the monolingual baselines across four SoE stages. The results show a difference between early and late reading measures.
blocks.zh: 图1显示了所解释的双语模式与四个索E阶段的单一语言基线之间的差别( R s s e d o 2 \Delta R_{pseudo}^{2})。 结果显示了早读和晚读措施的区别.

blocks.en: For first fixation duration, the bilingual surprisal provides no predictive advantage for L2 readers. The mean Δ ​ R p ​ s ​ e ​ u ​ d ​ o 2 \Delta R_{pseudo}^{2} for L2 readers starts near zero and drops slightly below zero at the SoE=48k. In contrast, for the later reading measures, the bilingual model yields a clear advantage. In both gaze duration and go-past time, the L2 mean is strictly positive and increases consistently with SoE. In total fixation time, the L2 mean remains positive and stable across all SoEs.
blocks.zh: 对于第一次固定时间,双语附加语为L2读者没有预测优势. 对L2读取器来说,平均值为 QQ R p s e u d o 2\ Delta R_{pseudo}^{2}开始于接近于0,在"SoE=48k"时会略低于0. 相反,对于后来的阅读措施,双语模式有明显的优势。 在视线持续时间和过去时间中,L2平均值都是绝对积极的,并且与SoE一致地增加. 在总固定时间中,L2平均值在所有SoEs中保持正和稳定.

blocks.en: Crucially, across gaze duration, go-past time, and total fixation duration, the native English control group stays close to zero and consistently below the L2 mean. This gap confirms that the bilingual models capture variance specific to non-native reading behavior, rather than offering a generic predictive improvement for all readers.
blocks.zh: 关键是,在整个视线、过去时间和总固定时间,当地英语控制组保持接近零,始终低于L2平均值。 这一差距证实双语模型捕捉出非本土阅读行为特有的差异,而不是为所有读者提供通用的预测改进.

blocks.en: 4.2 Are Matched Models Better Than Mismatched Models?
blocks.zh: 4.2 匹配模型比匹配模型更好吗?

blocks.en: Figure 2: Per-word Δ \Delta LL (scaled by 10 4 10^{4} ) between matched and mismatched models in four reading measures as a function of SoE. Solid lines and shaded bands represent subset means with 95% confidence intervals for the bilingual models (blue) and monolingual baseline (red), with faint blue lines indicating individual subset evaluations. Higher values indicate a stronger predictive advantage for the matched model relative the mismatched one. With the exception of first fixation duration, bilingual models match or outperform the monolingual baseline.

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates the non-nested per-word Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL between LMMs using matched and mismatched bilingual surprisals. To control for evaluation biases or tokenization artifacts, we include a monolingual baseline derived by treating each L1 monolingual LM as matched and comparing it against the other monolingual LMs. If the matched advantage is genuinely driven by bilingual cross-linguistic transfer, it should exceed this strictly monolingual baseline. Except for first fixation duration, the matched bilingual models consistently outperform their mismatched counterparts, and this advantage strengthens in later processing measures. Notably, go-past time is the only metric exhibiting a clear upward trend in matched model advantage as SoE increases. Although there is variance among individual subset traces (representing the mean per-word Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL between matched and mismatched models for each L1 subset), the matched bilingual models generally exceed the monolingual control.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了使用匹配和不匹配的双语辅助语言的LMM之间未记账的每个字的L L\Delta LL。 为了控制评价偏差或象征性的文物,我们列入一个单一语言基线,将每种L1单一语言的LM作为对应物,并将其与其他单一语言的LM进行对比。 如果匹配的优势真正由双语跨语言传承驱动,那么它应该超过这个严格的单一语言基线. 除了第一次固定期限外,对应的双语模式的业绩始终超过不匹配的对应模式,这种优势在以后的处理措施中得到加强。 值得注意的是,随着SoE的增加,过去的时间是唯一一个在相应的模型优势方面显示出明显上升趋势的指标。 虽然单个子集痕迹之间有差异(代表每个L1子集相匹配和不匹配的模型之间每字的平均值QQ L\Delta LL),但相匹配的双语模型一般会超过单一语言的控制.

blocks.en: The nested model results in Table 1 show whether this matched advantage provides unique explanatory variance. By evaluating both predictors simultaneously, we can assess which model contributes a greater share of unique information based on their mean Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL and significance ratios. These nested comparisons perfectly align with our non-nested findings. During early lexical access (first fixation duration), matched models offer no L1-specific predictive advantage, contributing less unique variance than mismatched models. In contrast, across all later reading measures (gaze duration, go-past time, and total fixation duration), the matched models contribute substantially more unique log-likelihood and achieve statistical significance at much higher rates than their mismatched counterparts.
blocks.zh: 表1的嵌入模型显示这一匹配优势是否提供了独特的解释性差异。 通过同时评价两个预测器,我们可以评估哪个模型根据其平均L-L-\Delta LL和意义比率贡献出更大份额的独特信息。 这些嵌入式的比较 完全符合我们未经确认的结果 在早期的词汇访问(第一次固定持续时间)期间,相匹配的模型不提供L1特异性的预测优势,与不匹配的模型相比,其贡献的独特差异较小. 相形之下,在以后的所有阅读量度(使用时间、使用时间和总固定时间)中,匹配模型有助于显著地更独特的对数法,并以远高于不匹配的对等方的速度实现统计意义。

blocks.en: Ultimately, even though the surprisal estimates from different bilingual models are highly correlated (see Appendix C for surprisal correlations), the matched models consistently explain significantly more unique variance during late-stage reading. These results indicate that bilingual LMs successfully capture aspects of L1-specific structural processing.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,尽管不同双语模式的追加估计高度相关(关于追加相关性,见附录C),但对应模型在后期阅读中始终能解释出明显更独特的差异. 这些结果表明,双语LMS成功地捕捉了L1特定结构处理的方面.

With the exception of First Fixation, matched models’ mean Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL and significance ratio are higher than the mismatched models.

blocks.en: 4.3 The Role of Script Overlap
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 脚本重叠的作用

blocks.en: A primary structural dimension separating the evaluated subsets is writing system overlap with English. We examine this effect by partitioning the results from Figure 2 by script. The Latin script group consists of 8 MECO subsets across 7 L1s, while the Non-Latin group consists of 6 subsets across 4 L1s (with the exception of go-past time, where the ch_s subset is missing). See Appendix A for details on the L1 subsets and their scripts.

blocks.en: This analysis is motivated by prior NLP research showing that shared scripts facilitate cross-lingual transfer in LMs Dhamecha et al. (2021) ; Moosa et al. (2023) , as well as psycholinguistic studies examining the processing dynamics of reading across different writing systems Miwa et al. (2013) ; Taylor and Mukai (2023) ; Arab (2026) .

blocks.en: Previous work demonstrates that L2 proficiency non-monotonically modulates the predictive power of monolingual surprisal Berzak and Levy (2023) . Inspired by this finding, we ask a novel question: how does the added predictive power of bilingual surprisal change with reader proficiency? We hypothesize an inverted-U relationship for this bilingual predictive advantage over the monolingual baseline. This advantage should be minimal at both extremes of the proficiency spectrum: beginners rely primarily on shallow, context-independent features such as word frequency Diependaele et al. (2013) ; Berzak and Levy (2023) , while advanced readers no longer depend on L1 transfer as their reading behavior approaches that of a native speaker Chen et al. (2026) . Consequently, the bilingual advantage should peak for intermediate readers, who possess enough fluency to engage in contextual prediction but still rely heavily on L1 syntactic biases during processing.
blocks.zh: 先前的作品表明,L2熟练程度非单调性地调节了单一语言的超音速Berzak和Levy(2023年)的预测力. 受这一发现的启发,我们问了一个新问题:双语的附加预测力如何随着读者的熟练程度而改变? 我们假设这种双语预测比单一语言基准优势的倒转-U关系。 这一优势在熟练程度谱系的两极都应该是最小的:初学者主要依靠浅而上下文独立的特征,如单词频率Diependaele等(2013年);Berzak和Levy(2023年),而高级读者不再依赖L1的转录,作为他们的读取行为接近母语的陈等(2026年). 因此,中级读者的双语优势应达到顶峰,他们有足够的流利度来进行背景预测,但在处理过程中仍然严重依赖L1合成偏差。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 4 , while early lexical access measures maintain a linear relationship (all p quad > 0.05 p_{\text{quad}}>0.05 ), late processing measures (go-past time and total fixation duration) display a pronounced inverted-U trajectory that strongly favors the quadratic polynomial ( Δ ​ AIC > 2.0 \Delta\text{AIC}>2.0 for SoE ≥ \geq 16k; Appendix D.2 ). Crucially, this curvature remains robust: go-past time shows significant quadratic modulation across all SoE ( 0.001 < p quad < 0.05 0.001<p_{\text{quad}}<0.05 ), and total fixation duration reaches significance for SoE ≥ \geq 16k ( p quad < 0.05 p_{\text{quad}}<0.05 ). The bilingual advantage peaks for intermediate readers ( 65 ​ – ​ 80 % 65\text{--}80\% LexTALE) and descends toward zero for the most advanced readers ( > 90 % >90\% LexTALE).
blocks.zh: 如图4所显示的,早期的词汇访问措施保持了线性关系(所有p turn > 0.05 p_{\text{quad}}>0.05),而后期处理措施(go-past time and total fixation dumption)显示出一个显著的倒向-U轨迹,强烈地有利于四极多诺米(XQ AIC > 2.0\Delta\text{AIC}>2.0 for SoE ^\\ geq 16k;附录D.2). 关键的是,这种曲率仍然很强:过去的时间表明,在所有SoE(0.001 < p equa 0.001 <p_{\text{quad}}<0.05)中,四相调和具有重大意义,总固定时间对SoE ≥\ geq 16k(pqua 0.05 p_{\text{quad}}<0.05)具有重大意义。 中间读者的双语优势峰值(65–80 % 65\text{-}80\ LexTALE),最高级读者的双语优势为零( > 90% > 90\ LexTALE)。

blocks.en: Our hypothesis of an inverted-U trajectory is thus confirmed, though it applies exclusively to late measures where contextual integration and syntactic reanalysis are prominent. Importantly, this pattern is not an artifact of LexTALE: evaluating a composite proficiency index extracted via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) across all five proficiency tests in MECO (see Appendix D.3 ) replicates this trajectory, confirming robust significance of non-monotonic moderation in go-past time (all SoEs) and total fixation duration (SoE=16k).
blocks.zh: 因此,我们关于反向U轨迹的假设得到了确认,尽管它只适用于背景整合和综合再分析突出的后期措施。 重要的是,这种模式并不是LexTALE的产物:通过主要成分分析(PCA)在MECO的所有五个能力测试(见附录D.3)中评估综合熟练程度指数,复制这一轨迹,证实非运动性节制在去时(所有SoEs)和总固定时间(SoE=16k)中的强烈意义。

blocks.en: To contextualize this result, Appendix D.1 visualizes the absolute explanatory power ( R 2 R^{2} ) of each model independently. As expected, both models exhibit an inverted-U trend across all metrics, corroborating Berzak and Levy (2023) by showing that general contextual prediction peaks for intermediate learners. Crucially, however, Figure 4 demonstrates that the differential advantage of the bilingual model ( Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} ) follows this non-linear trajectory strictly during late measures. This indicates that while intermediate readers generally rely on broad contextual expectations, their late-stage processing is more strongly influenced by native-language biases.
blocks.zh: 为了将这一结果背景化,附录D.1将每个模型的绝对解释力(R 2 R^{2})独立地直观化. 正如所预期的那样,两种模型在所有衡量标准中都呈现出倒向U的趋势,通过显示中学生的总体背景预测峰值,证实了Berzak和Levy(2023年). 但重要的是,图4显示,双语模式(XQR 2\Delta RXX2})的差分优势严格在后期措施中遵循这种非线性轨迹。 这表明,虽然中间读者一般依赖广泛的背景期望,但其后期处理更受当地语言偏见的影响.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigated whether bilingual LMs align with human cross-linguistic influence during L2 reading. Our findings demonstrate that bilingual LMs successfully capture aspects of L1-specific effects on L2 processing. Crucially, our two distinct evaluation frameworks—comparing bilingual LMs against a monolingual baseline (§ 4.1 ), and contrasting L1-matched against L1-mismatched bilingual LMs (§ 4.2 )—yield consistent results.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们调查了双语LM在L2读取过程中是否与人类跨语言影响相适应. 我们的调查结果表明,双语LMs成功地捕捉到L1对L2处理的具体影响。 关键的是,我们的两个不同的评价框架——对照单一语言的基线(第4.1节)比较双语的LMs,并将L1比作与L1相匹配的双语LMs(第4.2节)——取得了一致的结果。

blocks.en: Across both comparisons, we observed a progressive shift in predictive performance from early to late reading measures. The predictive advantage of bilingual surprisals is absent in first fixation duration, begins to emerge in gaze duration, and becomes most pronounced in late-stage measures such as go-past time and total fixation duration. Regarding the SoE, we generally did not observe a uniform effect on predictability across all measures. This lack of a generalized trend may occur because the impact of prolonged L1 training varies considerably across different L1-L2 language pairs. The notable exception is go-past time, which exhibits a consistent upward trend in predictability as SoE increases.
blocks.zh: 通过这两种比较,我们看到预测性能从早期的阅读量逐渐转向后读量. 双语补充药的预测优势在第一次固定期间是不存在的,在凝视期间开始出现,在后期措施,如走过时间和完全固定期间,变得最明显. 关于SoE,我们一般没有看到对所有措施的可预测性产生统一的影响。 由于不同L1-L2语言对长期L1培训的影响大相径庭,可能出现普遍趋势。 值得注意的例外是过去的时间,随着SoE的增加,预测率呈现出持续上升的趋势。

blocks.en: Our analysis of writing system overlap (§ 4.3 ) reveals a clear divergence in early processing. In gaze duration, only Latin L1 models showed a predictive advantage, whereas both script groups competed with or outperformed the monolingual baseline in late measures. These results can be interpreted through the Bilingual Interactive Activation (BIA+) model Dijkstra and van Heuven (2002) . When languages share a script, visual input can directly activate orthographic representations in both languages simultaneously, allowing cross-linguistic effects to emerge in early reading measures Miwa et al. (2013) . In contrast, when scripts differ, direct orthographic co-activation is blocked, delaying cross-linguistic influence until downstream phonological or semantic integration occurs Taylor and Mukai (2023) ; Miwa et al. (2013) . Consequently, cross-linguistic effects in Non-Latin groups emerge only in late-stage measures (go-past time and total fixation duration). While our findings cannot definitively confirm these specific cognitive mechanisms, this script-dependent processing divergence presents a compelling avenue for future investigation.
blocks.zh: 我们对书写系统重叠的分析(第4.3节)表明,早期处理存在明显的分歧。 在凝视持续时间中,只有拉丁L1模型显示出了预测优势,而两个脚本组在后期测量中都与单一语言基线相竞争或超过其表现. 这些结果可以通过双语互动激活(BIA+)模型Dijkstra和van Heuven (2002)来解释. 当语言共享一个脚本时,视觉输入可以同时直接激活两种语言的正体表达,允许在早期读取措施Miwa等(2013年)中出现跨语言效应. 相形之下,当剧本不同时,直接正文共活被阻断,将跨语言影响延后到下游的相声或语义融合发生泰勒和穆凯(2023年);米瓦等(2013年). 因此,非拉丁语群体的跨语言影响只在后期措施(过去的时间和总固定时间)中出现。 虽然我们的调查结果无法确切证实这些具体的认知机制,但这种依赖脚本的处理分歧为今后的调查提供了令人信服的途径。

blocks.en: Additionally, our results reveal that the bilingual predictive advantage is non-linearly modulated by reader proficiency (§ 4.4 ). We observed an inverted-U trajectory that peaks for intermediate L2 readers and diminishes for highly advanced learners. Importantly, this proficiency modulation is robustly constrained to late processing measures. This indicates that while intermediate learners rely heavily on broad contextual expectations, their reliance on L1-driven biases surfaces predominantly during late-stage processing.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的结果表明,双语预测优势不是以读者熟练程度为标准(第4.4节)。 我们观测到一个逆-U轨迹,它使中间L2读取器达到峰值,而对于高级学习者来说则逐渐减少. 重要的是,这种熟练程度的调制被严格限制在延迟处理措施之外。 这表明,虽然中间学习者在很大程度上依赖广泛的背景预期,但他们对L1驱动的偏差的依赖主要出现在后期处理中.

blocks.en: Across all findings, go-past time exhibits the most consistent alignment with L1-specific processing. Unlike the other reading measures that group eye fixations solely by location, go-past time groups fixations by sequence in time, directly measuring the time required to detect and resolve processing breakdowns Liversedge et al. (1998) ; Liversedge and Findlay (2000) ; Rayner (1998) . By incorporating L1 structural patterns, the bilingual models successfully predict the regressive eye movements associated with L1-L2 conflicts, cautioning future research against relying solely on early reading measures.
blocks.zh: 在所有调查结果中,过去的时间显示与L1特定处理最一致。 与其他仅按位置来组合眼部固定的读取措施不同,去-过去时间组按时间顺序固定,直接测量检测和解决处理故障所需的时间Liversedge等(1998年);Liversedge和Findlay(2000年);Rayner(1998年)。 通过纳入L1结构模式,双语模型成功地预测了与L1-L2冲突相联的后退眼运动,并提醒未来的研究不要仅仅依靠早期阅读措施.

blocks.en: In conclusion, our work bridges multilingual NLP and psycholinguistics by demonstrating that bilingual LMs internalize L1-specific predictive biases that mirror human non-native reading. Rather than a uniform advantage, we show that this cross-linguistic alignment is concentrated in late-stage structural processing and peaks among intermediate learners. Consequently, accurately modeling L2 reading requires evaluation frameworks that capture the full temporal complexity of non-native processing.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的工作将多种语言的NLP和心理语言学联系起来,表明双语LMs将反映人类非本土阅读的L1特定预测偏好内化。 我们显示,这种跨语言的对接不是统一的优势,而是集中在后期结构处理和中间学习者之间的峰值. 因此,精确地模拟L2读取需要能够反映非本地处理的全部时间复杂性的评价框架。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: While we have attempted to rigorously evaluate bilingual LMs on L2 sentence processing, several limitations remain.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们试图严格评估L2判决处理的双语LMs,但仍存在若干限制。

blocks.en: First, our evaluation is restricted to English as the target L2 and relies on a single eye-tracking corpus (MECO). Although MECO provides a rich diversity of L1 backgrounds, focusing exclusively on L2 English leaves it an open question whether our findings generalize to target languages with fundamentally different typological features, such as highly agglutinative languages or those with freer word order. Additionally, data collection for certain L1 subsets in MECO took place in regions where specific regional dialects or varieties of the language are spoken (e.g., Brazilian Portuguese). Because our bilingual models were trained on standard, general-domain corpora for each L1, this mismatch between standard pretraining text and regional variants may introduce noise and could explain some of the variation observed in individual model performance across subsets.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们的评价仅限于英语作为目标L2,并依赖于单一的眼跟踪器(MECO). 虽然MECO提供了丰富多彩的L1背景,但专注L2英语,让我们的发现是泛泛地针对具有根本不同类型特征的语言,如高度杂交语言还是有更自由的词序语言,这是一个有待解决的问题. 此外,在讲特定区域方言或语言品种(例如巴西葡萄牙语)的地区,对MECO某些L1子集的数据收集。 因为我们的双语模式对每个L1进行了标准、通用域域名培训,标准预训文本与区域变体之间的这种不匹配可能带来噪音,并能够解释各个子集中单个模型性能观察到的一些差异。

blocks.en: Second, while our script analysis groups languages based on their script overlap with English, this is only one axis of variation. Other typological factors, such as word order alignment and morphological similarity, likely affect L2 sentence processing. Future work should investigate how these broader structural overlaps independently modulate the predictive biases observed in L2 reading.
blocks.zh: 第二,虽然我们的脚本分析基于其脚本与英语相重叠的语言分组,但这只是一个变异轴. 其他类型学因素,如词序对接和形态相似性,都可能影响L2句处理. 今后的工作应研究这些更广泛的结构重叠如何独立地调和L2读取的预测偏差。

blocks.en: Third, our operationalization of reader proficiency relies on LexTALE, a metric shown to correlate with general L2 proficiency Lemhöfer and Broersma (2011) and widely adopted for this purpose (e.g., Diependaele et al. 2013 ; Cop et al. 2015 ; Caissie-Gilbert et al. 2026 ). However, its validity as a measure of global proficiency has been questioned Puig Mayenco et al. (2023) , as it is fundamentally a lexical measure. To address this, we demonstrated the robustness of our results using a PCA-derived composite score based on all proficiency metrics reported in the MECO corpus. Nevertheless, these combined metrics still primarily index lower-level skills such as vocabulary size and decoding efficiency. As a result, the extent to which other proficiency factors such as higher-level comprehension or syntactic awareness modulate L1-driven predictive biases remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们读者熟练程度的可操作性依赖于LexTALE。 LexTALE是一个与一般L2熟练程度有关的指标,Lemhöfer和Brersma(2011年),并被广泛采用(例如Diependale等)。 2013; Cop等2015; Caissie-Gilbert等2026.). 然而,它作为一种衡量全球熟练程度的尺度,其有效性受到了普伊格·马延科等(2023年)的质疑,因为它从根本上来说是一种法理衡量. 为了解决这一问题,我们利用根据多边环境协定报告的所有能力衡量标准得出的五氯苯甲醚综合分数,证明了我们成果的稳健性。 尽管如此,这些综合度量衡仍然主要索引较低的技能,如词汇大小和解码效率等. 因此,其他能力因素,如更高水平的理解或综合认识调节L1所驱动的预测偏差的程度,仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: Finally, we trained each model configuration using a single initialization seed. Although this precludes measuring variance across different weight initializations, we mitigate this limitation through the breadth of our experimental setup. Specifically, we trained four SoE bilingual models for each of the 11 L1s and compared them against corresponding monolingual baselines. By analyzing the consistency of these results across diverse languages and tracking how they evolve across SoE stages, we ensure that the observed bilingual advantage is a robust trend rather than an artifact of a specific model checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们用单一的初始化种子来训练每个模型配置. 虽然这排除了测量不同重量初始化的差异,但我们通过实验设置的宽度减轻了这一限制。 具体地说,我们为11个L1的每个单元培训了4个SoE双语模型,并与相应的单一语言基线进行比较。 通过分析不同语言之间这些结果的一致性并跟踪这些结果如何在SoE阶段演变,我们确保观察到的双语优势是一个强劲的趋势,而不是一个特定的示范检查站的文物。

blocks.en: Because all bilingual models in this study are trained and evaluated on English, their surprisal estimates for English text share substantial variance. We calculate the pairwise Pearson correlation of per-word surprisal across all L1 bilingual models using the 12 English texts from the MECO dataset. Figure 5 confirms this high overlap, showing that all pairwise correlations remain above 0.94. However, the mean correlation decreases slightly as SoE increases (from 0.96 to 0.95), suggesting that prolonged L1 exposure introduces small but noticeable L1-specific differences between models.
blocks.zh: 由于本研究中的所有双语模式都接受英语的培训和评价,因此其英文文本的附加估计有相当大的差异。 我们利用MECO数据集的12个英文文本,计算所有L1双语模型中每字的皮尔逊语的对等关系。 图5证实了这种高度的重叠,显示所有对等关系都保持在0.94以上。 然而,随着SoE的增加(从0.96降至0.95),平均相关性略有下降,这表明长期L1接触在模型之间产生了较小但明显的L1差异。

blocks.en: The absolute surprisal from both monolingual and bilingual models follows a highly similar inverted-U trajectory across proficiency levels, peaking for intermediate readers. This replicates the findings of Berzak and Levy (2023) , confirming that intermediate L2 readers rely most heavily on context-dependent expectations. Because the bilingual and monolingual LMs share a vast majority of their English linguistic representations (as evidenced by their high surprisal correlation), their individual lines overlap almost entirely. Crucially, in the late processing measures (go-past time and total fixation duration), the bilingual models consistently diverge from and peak slightly above the monolingual baseline. The subtraction methodology utilized in § 4.4 isolates this specific gap, confirming that the isolated cross-linguistic transfer effect also scales non-linearly with reader proficiency.

blocks.en: To verify that the non-linear proficiency moderation observed with LexTALE is not an artifact of this single metric, we evaluated whether these findings generalize across other proficiency measures reported in MECO Kuperman et al. (2025) . Specifically, we extracted a composite index via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) across five standardized assessments (LexTALE, vocabulary knowledge, spelling, TOWRE-2 test of words and nonwords), with the first principal component (PC1) accounting for 52.5 % 52.5\% of the total variance.
blocks.zh: 为了证实使用LexTALE观察到的非线性熟练度节制不是这一单一度量的产物,我们评价了这些结论是否将MECO Kuperman等人(2025年)报告的其他熟练度量概括起来。 具体而言,我们通过主要组成部分分析(PCA)从五个标准化评估(LexTALE、词汇知识、拼写、TOWRE-2词和非词测试)中提取了一个综合指数,第一个主要组成部分(PC1)占总差异的52.5%。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 7 , modeling Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} against PC1 closely mirrors the findings obtained with LexTALE alone. In early reading measures (first fixation duration and gaze duration), the quadratic term remains non-significant across all SoE (p>0.05), confirming our earlier findings using LexTALE. In contrast, late processing in go-past time robustly replicates the inverted-U trajectory across all SoE (p<0.05). For total fixation duration, the quadratic trajectory exhibits the same qualitative inverted-U curvature, although under strict L1-subset controls its statistical significance is attenuated relative to LexTALE, reaching significance only at SoE=16k. Overall, these results demonstrate that the bilingual processing advantage peaking among intermediate-proficiency readers in late-stage eye-movement measures generalizes across alternative proficiency assessments, particularly for go-past time.
blocks.zh: 如图7所显示的,模拟XQR 2\Delta R^{2}与PC1对齐,紧密地反映了仅用LexTALE获得的发现. 在早期读取措施(第一次固定时间和凝视时间)中,所有SoE(p>0.05)的四重词仍然不重要,证实了我们先前使用LexTALE的研究结果。 相形之下,后期的后期处理能有力地复制所有SoE(p<0.05)的倒转-U轨迹。 在总固定期内,四相轨迹显示出相同的质量倒转-U曲率,尽管在严格的L1-子集控制下,相对于LexTALE,其统计意义被削弱,只在SoE=16k时才有意义. 总体而言,这些结果表明,在后期眼动措施中,双语处理优势在中等熟练程度的读者中达到顶峰,这种优势贯穿于其他能力评估中,特别是在超时。
